concepts.definition: Open, high, low, close and traded volume for an instrument and interval.
Quantity traded in an interval, in instrument-specific units (shares for equity).
Share of cash-market traded quantity that settled by delivery; not investor buying.
Outstanding derivative contracts at an observation; not traded volume.
Volatility parameter implied by an option price under a stated model.
Issuer events that change price comparability or entitlements.
Reported financial performance for an accounting period.
Disclosed trades by persons covered by insider-disclosure rules.
Cross-sectional participation across a defined universe; market-wide, one value per day.
Persistence of a past return over a stated horizon.
Deviation of price from a reference, expected to close.
Magnitude of price fluctuation over a stated window.
Distribution of securities among reported holder categories.
Market state used to re-weight engines; a gate, not alpha.

instruments.definition: Listed share, identified by NSE symbol (the only canonical identifier).
Calculated benchmark; not tradable. Keyed by index name, not NSE symbol.
Standardized contract on an underlying with an expiry (stock and index futures).
Contract with underlying, expiry, strike and call/put side (stock and index options).
Exchange-traded fund. DECLARED ONLY: no ETF table exists and nse_stocks name-matches at most one.

signals.availability: End of session `date`; the card's expected lag is 5h. Not knowable intraday.
caveats: Mixing adjustment_basis inside one series corrupts a backtest silently.
Filter is_suspect = 0 before building a panel; suspect bars are flagged, not deleted.
History starts 2021-01; names delisted before today may be absent (price paths iterate the current nse_stocks master).
signals.definition: Open, high, low, close in INR/share and volume in shares for one NSE session; one row per (symbol, date). Price basis is per row in adjustment_basis (nse_bhavcopy_raw, split_only, split_dividend).
signals.label: Daily OHLCV bar
signals.measured: Data, not a signal: no edge claim.
signals.name: daily_ohlcv

signals.availability: End of session `date`.
caveats: Not adjusted by a split unless adjustment_basis says so: a split halves price and doubles shares.
signals.definition: stock_ohlcv.volume: shares traded in the session.
signals.label: Traded volume
signals.measured: Data, not a signal.
signals.name: traded_volume

signals.availability: End of session t, once stock_ohlcv for t exists; feature_store card lag 5h.
caveats: Counts rows, not calendar days: a missing bar silently lengthens the window.
Crossing an unadjusted split or bonus fabricates a +/-50% return; check adjustment_basis.
signals.definition: ret_{d}d = close_t / close_(t-d) - 1 for d in 1, 5, 15, 21, 63, 126, 252 trading rows (feature_engineering.py, pandas pct_change on the symbol's own rows).
signals.label: Trailing close-to-close return
signals.measured: ret_21d / ret_63d / reversal_21d: negative, t down to -3.96, dead (measurement.md 'Already tested').
signals.name: trailing_return

signals.availability: End of session t.
caveats: Difference form overstates names whose 21d return is large and negative.
signals.definition: feature_store.ret_12m_ex1m = close.pct_change(252) - close.pct_change(21): a DIFFERENCE of two simple returns, not the compounded skip-month return (1+r252)/(1+r21)-1.
signals.label: 12-month return excluding the last month
signals.measured: Not demonstrated. 2026-10-27 re-run: +0.80%/period vs universe, t 1.67 (25 bps/side, 56 periods); a later H1 run is VOID on a defective split/bonus adjustment panel (measurement.md).
signals.name: momentum_12_1

signals.availability: End of session t.
caveats: Column name says percent, value is a fraction.
signals.definition: (close - sma20) / sma20, sma20 = close.rolling(20).mean() including today.
signals.label: Distance from 20-day mean
signals.measured: No standalone verdict recorded; see mean_reversion_14.
signals.name: dist_sma20_pct

signals.availability: End of session t; only as available as its slowest input.
caveats: The constituent list lives in factor_backtest.py; cite its commit with any result.
signals.definition: Research composite in factor_backtest.py: sign-flipped combination of 14 feature_store factors that measured negative. NOT a stored column; recompute from feature_store.
signals.label: Mean-reversion composite
signals.measured: Standalone long factor significantly NEGATIVE: 67 periods, net excess -0.94%/period, t -3.26, 0/6 years positive (2026-09-26). The veto-on-momentum arm is undecided (measured through a defective panel).
signals.name: mean_reversion_14

signals.availability: End of session t.
signals.definition: std of 21 daily log returns * sqrt(252) (feature_engineering.py).
signals.label: 21-day realised volatility
signals.measured: Risk descriptor; no directional verdict. Strong-looking factors here have been volatility detectors (reverse audit).
signals.name: hist_vol_21d

signals.availability: End of session t.
signals.definition: atr_14 / close (feature_engineering.py).
signals.label: ATR as a share of price
signals.measured: Risk descriptor; no directional verdict.
signals.name: atr_pct

signals.availability: End of session t.
caveats: Including today in the denominator compresses spikes; not comparable with a prior-20-day baseline.
signals.definition: vol / vol.rolling(20).mean(); the 20-row mean INCLUDES today's volume.
signals.label: Relative volume
signals.measured: No verdict recorded.
signals.name: volume_ratio_20d

signals.availability: T+1: the value for session D is published after D and is knowable only during D+1 (card lag 24h).
caveats: A same-session join is a look-ahead.
stock_delivery_volume is a sibling table with different column names and coverage.
signals.definition: stock_delivery_data.delivery_pct: delivery_qty / traded_qty * 100 for the session, as published by NSE.
signals.label: Delivery percentage
signals.measured: Raw level: quintile spread +0.19pp/day, t +7.82, but long-only top-50 net -1.04%/period (21d, 25 bps) and -0.15%/period (5d, 15 bps): dead as a long-only factor.
signals.name: delivery_pct

signals.availability: T+1, same as delivery_pct.
caveats: Two different 'delivery z' definitions coexist; name which one a result used.
signals.definition: (delivery_pct_t - mean20) / std20 over rolling(20, min_periods=10) INCLUDING day t (feature_engineering.py). Differs from the ontology metric delivery_surprise_z, whose baseline is the 20 sessions BEFORE t.
signals.label: Delivery z-score
signals.measured: Closest tested analogues delivery_spike / delivery_trend: t -1.08 / -1.43, dead.
signals.name: delivery_z_20d

signals.availability: After the vendor publishes the session; use fetched_at, not date. No row exists before the first fetch day, so this cannot be backfilled.
caveats: Source column is moneycontrol only; the panel is short, so any reading is a calendar artefact until a year exists.
OI has a buyer and a seller for every contract: it does not show direction.
signals.definition: stock_futures_oi_history.open_interest: outstanding futures contracts for (symbol, expiry) on the session, as served by Moneycontrol.
signals.label: Futures open interest
signals.measured: LOW-DATA: oi_change 5d IC +0.078 / AUC 0.532 on 13 dates; 1d no edge (measurement.md).
signals.name: futures_open_interest
signals.unit: contracts as served (lot_size column gives shares per lot)

signals.availability: After the vendor publishes the session; use fetched_at, not date. No row exists before the first fetch day.
caveats: Expiry roll days mix two series: check expiry before differencing.
signals.definition: stock_futures_oi_history.oi_change (absolute) and oi_pct_change (percent) versus the previous session for the same expiry, vendor-computed.
signals.label: Futures OI change
signals.measured: No edge at 1d; 5d LOW-DATA (see futures_open_interest).
signals.name: futures_oi_change

signals.availability: After the vendor publishes the session; use fetched_at, not date. No row exists before the first fetch day.
caveats: Futures uses 'Buildup'; the option chain uses 'Build Up': never compare the strings across tables.
A label from OI alone is impossible: it needs both futures OI and a price change.
Vendor label, not recomputed here.
signals.definition: stock_futures_oi_history.oi_buildup in {Long Buildup, Short Buildup, Long Unwinding, Short Covering}: the vendor's classification of the sign of price change against the sign of OI change (price up + OI up = Long Buildup; price down + OI up = Short Buildup; price down + OI down = Long Unwinding; price up + OI down = Short Covering). The price reference the vendor uses is not documented. Option rows carry the same idea per strike in so_option_chain.ce_buildup / pe_buildup.
signals.label: Futures OI buildup label
signals.measured: No verdict recorded for the label; its inputs (oi_change) show no edge and the panel is short.
signals.name: oi_buildup

signals.availability: After the exchange file for the session is parsed; use fetched_at.
caveats: Two columns of the same name from two writers: state which one.
signals.definition: next_oi / (near_oi + next_oi) * 100 at the session (fno_rollover_fetcher.py); a second vendor-served rollover_pct exists in stock_futures_oi_history.
signals.label: Futures rollover share
signals.measured: Negative, LOW-DATA (measurement.md).
signals.name: rollover_pct

signals.availability: After the exchange file for the session is parsed; use fetched_at, not date.
caveats: Undefined when days_to_expiry <= 0.
signals.definition: (near_close - spot) / spot * 100 / days_to_expiry * 365 (fno_rollover_fetcher.py); spot is the file's underlying price.
signals.label: Annualised cost of carry
signals.measured: Tested as futures carry on the 2021-01..2024-07 panel; read that measurement.md entry before quoting a number.
signals.name: cost_of_carry_ann

signals.availability: After the vendor snapshot; use fetched_at.
caveats: A grid: one session yields many rows per symbol; a naive join multiplies parent rows.
Stock option-chain history is far shallower than the index panels.
signals.definition: so_option_chain.ce_oi / pe_oi: outstanding call / put contracts for (symbol, date, expiry, strike).
signals.label: Option open interest by strike
signals.measured: Data, not a signal.
signals.name: option_open_interest

signals.availability: End of trade_date for the exchange file; the table was loaded retrospectively, so fetched_at is load time, not publication time.
caveats: Options-derived: it cannot exist without option OI.
nt_index_pcr_ts carries three PCRs (OI, volume, change-in-OI); they are not interchangeable.
stock_option_features_history ends 2024-07-05 at time of writing.
signals.definition: put_oi / call_oi, each summed over EVERY strike of the nearest option expiry strictly after the trade date (nse_fo_bhav_history_fetcher.py); in shares. Index form: index_max_pain.pcr_oi and nt_index_pcr_ts.pcr.
signals.label: Put-call ratio by open interest
signals.measured: Descriptive only: IC +0.010, its book loses 0.36% net (2026-10-09 pre-registered run).
signals.name: pcr_oi

signals.availability: End of trade_date for the exchange file; the table was loaded retrospectively, so fetched_at is load time, not publication time.
caveats: so_option_chain.ce_iv / pe_iv are vendor values in PERCENT points (35.25), this column is a fraction: never mix them.
spot_proxy in the same table is derived from the future, so forward/spot_proxy is a constant (a trap for carry studies).
signals.definition: Black-76 on the forward F, r = 6.5%, T = calendar days to expiry / 365; OTM-side IVs (puts <= F, calls >= F) interpolated linearly in strike to F; only contracts that traded are priced (nse_fo_bhav_history_fetcher.py). F = same-expiry future settle, else put-call parity on the traded pair with the smallest |C-P|.
signals.label: At-the-money implied volatility
signals.measured: No verdict recorded.
signals.name: atm_iv

signals.availability: End of trade_date for the exchange file; the table was loaded retrospectively, so fetched_at is load time, not publication time.
signals.definition: IV(traded OTM put nearest 0.95F) - IV(traded OTM call nearest 1.05F), each within 2.5% moneyness of target (nse_fo_bhav_history_fetcher.py); positive = downside put bid.
signals.label: Put-call implied-volatility skew
signals.measured: H5 FAIL, wrong sign: IC +0.024 at 5 sessions against a negative prediction, -0.49% net (measurement.md, 2026-10-09).
signals.name: skew_95_105

signals.availability: End of trade_date for the exchange file; the table was loaded retrospectively, so fetched_at is load time, not publication time.
signals.definition: (ATM call close + ATM put close) / spot_proxy * 100; NULL unless both legs traded.
signals.label: ATM straddle size
signals.measured: Descriptive only: IC -0.019.
signals.name: straddle_pct

signals.availability: After the vendor snapshot; use fetched_at.
signals.definition: Strike minimising total option-writer payout for the expiry (a mechanical calculation, index_max_pain.max_pain).
signals.label: Index max pain
signals.measured: Unvalidated research candidate; a mechanical value, not a prediction.
signals.name: index_max_pain

signals.availability: Effective on ex_date. The ANNOUNCEMENT date is not stored (ingested_at is load time), so the table is not point-in-time for when an action became known.
caveats: Carries 'Quarterly Results' rows that are not capital actions: filter action_type.
The NSE-sourced rows never populate ratio; history before the NSE writer comes from yfinance.
Demergers and rights are not share-ratio actions: a mechanical 2:1 reading is wrong.
signals.definition: One row per (symbol, ex_date, action_type): DIVIDEND, DIVIDEND_SPECIAL, BONUS, SPLIT, OTHER, with ratio and amount where parsed. Used to adjust prices.
signals.label: Corporate action event
signals.measured: Infrastructure: no edge claim.
signals.name: corporate_action_event
signals.unit: event; amount in INR/share; ratio unitless

signals.availability: After the vendor publishes the quarter; use fetched_at. `quarter` is a fiscal label (Q2FY26), not a date.
caveats: Sequencing the quarter label as a string sorts wrongly across a year boundary.
Estimate vintage is not stored: the consensus may be post-revision.
signals.definition: eps_surprise_history.eps_surprise: reported EPS versus the vendor consensus estimate for the fiscal quarter, as served by Moneycontrol.
signals.label: EPS surprise
signals.measured: earnings_beat_yoy / qoq underpowered (3-27 periods), calendar-blocked until ~12+ months exist.
signals.name: eps_surprise_pct

signals.availability: broadcast_ts (UTC), the earliest knowable time; fetched/first-observed timestamps can be later.
caveats: Original versus revision labelling must be preserved; bank and insurer formats differ.
signals.definition: One row per NSE integrated filing (nse_results_filings) with broadcast_ts, and parsed financial facts in nse_filing_financials. broadcast_ts is the first moment the result was public on the exchange.
signals.label: Results filing event
signals.measured: Results strength is forecastable before filing (learned IC 0.41); the price reaction is not (IC ~0) (memory: earnings preview, 2026-10-27).
signals.name: earnings_filing_event

signals.availability: Trade date + 7 calendar days (disclosure lag).
caveats: insider_trades stores the trade date, not the disclosure date.
ESOP, gift, pledge, inter-se and allotment rows are excluded as carrying no price view.
signals.definition: buy_qty / (buy_qty + sell_qty) over a 90-calendar-day window of OPEN-MARKET insider trades; a trade counts from date_iso + 7 calendar days; windows with no trade read 0.5 (neutral), never 0 (insider_features.py).
signals.label: Insider buy share, 90 days
signals.measured: insider_net +0.29%/period, t 1.73: not significant. PIT net buying IC -0.014 (descriptive).
signals.name: insider_buy_pct_90d

signals.availability: End of session `date`.
caveats: Normalise trade_type with UPPER() before netting buys and sells.
Four overlapping deal tables exist (block_deals, bulk_deals, bulk_block_deals, nse_bulk_block_deals): dedupe before summing.
signals.definition: block_deals.value_cr: deal value in CRORES; qty in shares; trade_type mixed case.
signals.label: Block / bulk deal value
signals.measured: smart_money composite (insider + block + institutional deals): rank IC -0.000 / AUC 0.502 (h1), -0.020 / 0.484 (h5) at 2026-08-29: weak.
signals.name: block_deal_value

signals.availability: End of session; computed_at is the write time.
caveats: Universe is this platform's own: not comparable with a vendor breadth series.
signals.definition: above.sum / sma-valid.sum across the platform's own universe, close > rolling(200) mean (market_breadth.py).
signals.label: Share of universe above 200-day mean
signals.measured: Market-wide: zero cross-sectional variance, so not a stock-selection factor; context only.
signals.name: pct_above_200dma

signals.availability: End of session, after stock_ohlcv for that date exists; computed_at is the write time.
caveats: feature_store.advance_decline_ratio comes from a different writer: check before joining.
signals.definition: advancers / (advancers + decliners) versus the prior close (market_breadth.py). Note: this is a SHARE in [0,1], not the conventional advancers/decliners ratio.
signals.label: Advancer share of movers
signals.measured: Market-wide context only.
signals.name: adv_decline_ratio

signals.availability: End of session, after stock_ohlcv for that date exists; computed_at is the write time.
signals.definition: fraction of universe making a fresh 20-day high (market_breadth.py).
signals.label: Share of universe at a 20-day high
signals.measured: Market-wide context only.
signals.name: pct_at_20d_high

signals.availability: End of session, after stock_ohlcv for that date exists; computed_at is the write time.
signals.definition: (new 52-week highs - new 52-week lows) / universe (market_breadth.py).
signals.label: Net 52-week highs minus lows
signals.measured: Market-wide context only.
signals.name: net_highs_lows

signals.availability: After the evening publication; the first value is provisional.
caveats: Provisional exchange figures are revised.
signals.definition: fii_dii_flow.fii_net: FII buy minus sell in the cash segment as published, INR crore (source's convention; the schema does not declare the unit). feature_store.fii_3d_net / fii_10d_net are rolling(3) / rolling(10) sums of it.
signals.label: FII net cash flow
signals.measured: Market-wide: not a stock-selection factor; context only.
signals.name: fii_net_cash

signals.availability: After the nightly regime job; use computed_at.
caveats: History is short relative to price history: report per-regime n.
signals.definition: market_regimes.regime with regime_prob from the HMM state; used to re-blend engine weights.
signals.label: Market regime label
signals.measured: A weight gate, not alpha; treating it as a signal inverts its role.
signals.name: market_regime

signals.availability: After disclosure; fetched_at.
caveats: Disclosure-grain, not daily: state the carry-forward rule in any panel.
signals.definition: stock_mf_holdings.mf_holding_pct: share of equity held by mutual funds for a disclosure period, with num_funds and chg_vs_prev.
signals.label: Mutual-fund holding
signals.measured: No verdict recorded.
signals.name: mf_holding_pct

signals.availability: After the evening unified-ranker run; use the history table's generated_at.
caveats: Not a calibrated probability.
signals.definition: unified_recommendations.unified_score from unified_ranker.py: the platform's one ranking. Never write a parallel 'final' score.
signals.label: Canonical ranking score
signals.measured: No demonstrated forward-return edge; top quintile worst at 5d (memory 2026-10-25).
signals.name: unified_score
signals.unit: score as defined by the ranker
